companies.title: Companies
companies.description: Company slugs to run (see src/companies.js), e.g. related, glenwood. Empty = all enabled companies.

maxPerCompany.title: Max rows per company
maxPerCompany.description: Cap on rows pushed per company. 0 = no cap.

maxItems.title: Max rows overall
maxItems.description: Cap on total rows pushed. 0 = no cap.

concurrency.title: Companies in parallel
concurrency.description: How many companies are crawled at once. Requests within a company are always serial.

delayMs.title: Delay between requests (ms)
delayMs.description: Minimum gap between two requests to the same company's site.

ignoreIntervals.title: Refresh every company now
ignoreIntervals.description: Ignore per-company minIntervalHours (used to throttle expensive browser companies) and re-crawl everything.

datacenterProxyGroup.title: Datacenter proxy group
datacenterProxyGroup.description: Apify datacenter proxy group used only for hosts that refuse direct connections from Apify.
